sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT 1 AS month_num, '2019-01-01' AS mth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month_num + 1, 
           CAST((DATE '2019-01-01' + INTERVAL (month_num) MONTH) AS VARCHAR)
    FROM months
    WHERE month_num < 12
)
SELECT month_num, mth FROM months
